text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed, a truly exquisite delicacy!!
Hats off to this mille-feuille.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the brandy in the sponge base really came through...
It paired wonderfully with the coffee.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ? Um, is something wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No. ...The softness has returned to her expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When Teio told me about the new menu here,
your face came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear it suited your tastes.
Did it help soothe your exhaustion, even just a little?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be that you were concerned for me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If my fatigue shows on my face, then I am still quite inexperienced...
I shall correct myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If anything were to happen to you, I would be the one
at a complete loss. So please, no need to be so formal."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Shall we take a short walk, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Even with dusk approaching,
it's still comfortably warm whenever the sun is out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Um. President—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To all Umamusume,
you are, so to speak, the sun shining brilliantly overhead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To use another metaphor, I wish to be the earth.
The soil of happiness from which dreams may sprout.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A sprouting dream finds hope in the pouring sunlight.
And so it stretches its stem, blooming into a flower.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You are the sun, and I am the earth.
Together we shall fulfill our ambitions and create a utopia for Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You are you, and I am me. Please don't view what I possess
as something that you are lacking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
............
...I am deeply grateful for your kind words.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The President possesses lofty ambitions and broad foresight.
She consistently demonstrates the ideal of what one ought to be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is why, when encouraged, I feel tempted to lean on you.
I feel tempted to raise both hands in total agreement...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However... I am...!
After quietly recounting the events of the other day, she continued with eyes shining with fierce resolve.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to be the sun.
—However, that would mean..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It must be a sun that enchants even the vast earth...
One that makes it yearn to reach out!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I cannot show a back that even the "Emperor" would chase,
how could I ever call myself the "Empress"?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We train, Trainer.
Until we reach whatever heights await us!!
choice_data_list: Let's captivate everyone with your greatest weapon!
Let's captivate everyone with your weapon!
I'm gonna be a cosmic-scale Trainer!
I'm gonna become a trainer on a cosmic scale!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We train, Trainer.
Until we reach whatever heights await us!!
choice_data_list: Let's captivate everyone with your greatest weapon!
Let's captivate everyone with your weapon!
I'm gonna be a cosmic-scale Trainer!
I'm gonna become a trainer on a cosmic scale!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A weapon, huh... Heh, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter who blocks my path,
in the end, I will be the one to rule this race!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You too, keep your eyes on me without blinking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to captivate everyone with the "Empress's" final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, no, so that's it.
Because I'm the sun... I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, you... k-haha.
I wondered what you were blurting out out of nowhere, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever. That laugh helped shake off the tension.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us firmly take another step
toward our ideals today!
